paper_title: Mapping heterogeneous molecular subtypes of circadian misalignment underlying lung adenocarcinoma risk
study_design: Retrospective public bulk-transcriptomic classification, external NTP assignment and outcome/annotation analysis, with separate computational treatment-response hypotheses
evidence_type: Human tumor-expression associations and cross-cohort assessment; genomic/immune annotations and computational drug/response prediction
claim: The article reports an exploratory comparison of 151 existing prognostic signatures within TCGA subtypes.
context: Risk scores were recalculated and candidate signatures compared within the same TCGA data. These best-candidate C-index values are exploratory within-cohort discrimination, not external performance or prospective utility. The Chen EG (2017) attribution remains unresolved because reference 41 does not clearly identify the claimed prognostic model.

limitations: ["Retrospective and largely computational evidence; no prospective subtype-guided treatment trial or direct patient circadian-physiology experiment is reported.","The seven LUAD input counts sum arithmetically to 2090.
